payload.title: One-command strict V9 closure, then physical Andreas BASE14
payload.work_clay: LATEST REVISION WINS. Pull newest main. GitHub-hosted Actions is currently negative infrastructure evidence and must not be interpreted as a parser failure. On the verified local Ubuntu executor install/verify lark plus interegular, then run exactly: python3 tools/claycode_v9_strict_local_closure.py. This one fail-closed command must produce research_entity/claycode/base/receipts/LOCAL_V9_STRICT_CLOSURE.json with pass=true and internally bind strict-LALR, exact G9 V3 frontend, exact Dialect V3 frontend, canonical syntax, typed declaration IR for both corpora, typed declaration self-test, production canonicalizer default, package versions, git HEAD and the exact V9 grammar SHA. Preserve every component receipt. Do not switch the release grammar to V10 or V15 from sandbox evidence: both are non-promoted unification candidates unless a strict integrated discriminator plus explicit adjudication supersedes V9. After LOCAL_V9_STRICT_CLOSURE passes, on the registered physical Andreas Ubuntu host run bash tools/claycode_bootstrap_andreas_self_hosted_runner.sh and python3 tools/claycode_run_andreas_target_acceptance.py. The target collector and final assembler independently require V9 WP02 grammar identity. Never weaken host identity, clean-tree, real desktop, authority, APP01-10, five-path FULL_FRANK, P0/P1 or WP14 gates. frank_runtime.clay remains CONTEXT_ONLY_NON_GATE unless explicitly selected as a production executable.
payload.reason_clay: The hosted Actions path was reproduced as a pre-Step-1 infrastructure failure. A one-command local V9 strict runner now removes partial-run and grammar-drift ambiguity. The physical target collector was independently hardened on main to require the same V9 grammar identity. V15 currently addresses V9/V7 cross-stage unification and has non-promoting sandbox differential evidence, not a release-grade falsifier of V9.
payload.completion_clay: Complete only when LOCAL_V9_STRICT_CLOSURE pass=true, the physical Andreas scoped runner/autoprobe is online, target acceptance emits the V9-bound strict receipt and all required component receipts, ten real application receipts pass, five-path FULL_FRANK passes with no semantic escape hatch, WP14 independently passes, open P0/P1 remains zero, and CLAYCODE_GENERAL_PURPOSE_COMPILER_MANIFEST promotes GENERAL_PURPOSE_GATE and claycode_release_gate_pass to true from evidence.
payload.executor_policy: verified local Ubuntu executor for strict parser/canonical evidence; registered physical Andreas Ubuntu host for release-target/application/FULL_FRANK/WP14 evidence; always re-read latest main; preserve negative receipts; model output != execution authority
